Liberation war ministry jt secy made OSD
2014-04-22T17:14:07+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/liberation-war-ministry-jt-secy-made-osd-21125

Abul Kashem Talukdar, joint secretary of Ministry of Liberation War Affairs, has been made Officer on Special Duty (OSD) today for allegedly obtaining fake freedom fighters’ certificate.

The public administration ministry issued a gazette notification in this regard today, reports Bangla daily Prothom Alo.

The action was taken following a report published in Prothom Alo on January 22 with a title ‘Rush for freedom fighters’ certificate just before the retirement (Chakrir Shesh Shomoy e muktijoddha sanad neyar hirik) .

The report said at least four secretaries, one joint secretary and a former secretary have obtained fake freedom fighters’ certificate.
